script:
_G.dc = 'Y'

local train = workspace.train
local car = train.car
local camper = workspace.train.camper
----------------------------------------
local doorsChildren = car.doors:GetChildren()
local doors = {}
for _, door in pairs(doorsChildren) do
	table.insert(doors, door.click.ClickDetector)
end

local headLights = car.headlightsButton.buttonPart.ClickDetector
local bathroomDoors = camper.bathroomDoor.click.ClickDetector
local camperDoor = camper.door.click.ClickDetector
local beanCola = train.trailer.vendingMachine.icons.beanColaIcon.ClickDetector
local hatchDoor = camper.roof.emergencyHatch.hatch.clickPart.ClickDetector

while _G.dc == 'Y' do
	for _, door in pairs(doors) do
		fireclickdetector(door)
	end
	fireclickdetector(headLights)
	fireclickdetector(bathroomDoors)
	fireclickdetector(camperDoor)
	fireclickdetector(beanCola)
    fireclickdetector(hatchDoor)
    wait()
end
